title: H.R.Hygiene Products IPO Details
intro:
H.R. Hygiene Products IPO is a book build issue of ₹53.95 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 0.49 crore shares aggregating to ₹43.17 crores and offer for sale of 0.12 crore shares aggregating to ₹10.79 crores.

H.R. Hygiene Products IPO bidding opened for subscription on Jul 29, 2026 and will close on Jul 31, 2026. The allotment for the H.R. Hygiene Products IPO is expected to be finalized on Aug 3, 2026. H.R. Hygiene Products IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Aug 5, 2026.

H.R. Hygiene Products IPO is set issue price band at ₹83 to ₹88 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,600 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,81,600 (3,200 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (4,800 shares), amounting to ₹4,22,400.

Marwadi Chandarana Intermediaries Brokers Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Purva Sharegistry (India) Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is SMC Global Securities Ltd.

Refer to H.R. Hygiene Products IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in 2016, H.R. Hygiene Products Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and marketing of hygiene products (sanitary napkins). The company operates under multiple in-house brands Femiss, Womanica, ElderFit, and Bloom Baby designed to address hygiene and personal care needs across various consumer segments, from babies and young women to the elderly. The company’s core business focuses on sanitary napkins, which it manufactures under both its own brands and white-label arrangements for select customers. Over time, it has expanded its product portfolio to include female care, adult care, and baby care products, catering to diverse consumer requirements.

Product Portfolio: As of March 31, 2026, the company offered 2 products across 2 segments, serving personal, healthcare, and institutional hygiene needs through B2B and B2C channels, with products priced between ₹10 and ₹1,000 per pack.

Femiss targets the affordable hygiene segment with reliable sanitary napkins, Womanica offers premium high-absorbency products, ElderFit provides adult care solutions such as absorbent adult diapers, and Bloom Baby focuses on baby diapers designed for comfort and skin safety.

H.R. Hygiene Products distributes its products pan-India through a dual-channel strategy an extensive offline retail network supported by consignment sale agents and distributors, and online sales through major e-commerce platforms including Meesho, Amazon, Glowroad, Flipkart, Snapdeal, and JioMart.

As of March 31, 2026, the company operated with 25 Consignment Sale Agents (CSAs) and a network of 202 distributors, supported by a sales and marketing team of over 99 personnel. It had a diversified customer base of over 227 customers in 28 states and 8 union territories, reducing dependency on any single customer.
The company’s manufacturing facility is located in Rajkot, enabling efficient production and nationwide supply.
As of May 31, 2026, the company had a total of 144 employees.
strengths: Distribution of personal health & hygiene products through Dual Channel Strategy
Brand affinity, loyalty and trust of customers in the brands
Founder-led company with a strong professional management

faqs.question: How to apply in H.R. Hygiene Products IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in H.R. Hygiene Products IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in H.R. Hygiene Products IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in H.R. Hygiene Products IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' H.R. Hygiene Products IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.
